name: print-social-orange-and-grey-smartphone-promo-post-grid
title: Six orange, grey and white smartphone promo posts with product renders and bold headlines
whatItIs: A 3x2 grid of posts for phone retail: headlines like 'Upgrade your Gadget today!' with gadget renders, a portrait of a man holding an orange phone, 'Capture the Extra ordinary' with lens close-ups, and bold black 'UPGRADE WITH MORE VALUE' cards, all in orange and grey with rounded orange shapes.
whatItMeans: Punchy and commercial; orange rounded blocks make products feel active.
techniques: Frame product renders with big orange shapes.
Use bold headlines with tight leading.

vocabulary.definition: A big rounded orange shape behind the product.
Multiple ads for a store or product line.
A macro of the camera module.
